observations: Black car battery with white, blue, and red labels.
Brand 'EGO' and 'Maxpower' are prominent on the front and top labels.
Model 'MP28' and specifications '12V 100Ah 900A EN' are printed on the labels.
The battery has two top-mounted terminals; the positive terminal appears to have some residue or wear.
Labels show some scuffing and dirt, consistent with a used item.
A date grid is visible on the top label in photo 2, but no marks are clearly punched to indicate the manufacture or sale date.

claims.evidence: The brand EGO/Emrol is European, but no 'Made in Germany' mark is visible in the photos.
Visual condition of the labels and terminals indicates previous use.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or unable to hold a significant charge.
risks.proof: A video showing a load test or a multimeter reading above 12.6V.
risks.if_unproven: as a scrap or core battery

risks.risk: The battery may be several years old and near the end of its service life.
risks.proof: A clear photo of a date stamp on the plastic casing or a punched date on the top label.

proof_requests: A video of a battery load test showing the health and cranking amps.
A clear photo of any date codes engraved on the plastic body or the punched date grid on top.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand, model, and capacity. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a used battery of unknown health.
